title: Break the Staging Activation Gateway bootstrap deadlock without widening execution authority

phases.objective: Keep the internal Smart One-Click bootstrap local-only so canonical Windows service tunnel transition can occur before Activation Gateway exact-commit readiness is enforced.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Invoke-Staging-One-Click.ps1 with EnableActivationGateway and a governed public Staging tunnel mode
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The local bootstrap no longer reacquires the Activation Gateway execution gate; the Core preserves the flag and applies it only around the canonical tunnel transition and governed readiness checks.
steps: Run the internal bootstrap with -NoTunnel without forwarding -EnableActivationGateway into the local-only bootstrap phase.
Re-apply the Activation Gateway flag at the Core environment boundary before and after bootstrap, then continue through the canonical tunnel transition and readiness checks.
Refresh the registered portable Staging manifest only through the governed generated-artifact writer and require live Staging certification before merge readiness.
assertions: The bootstrap argument list contains -NoTunnel and does not append -EnableActivationGateway.
The Core preserves EnableActivationGateway across the bootstrap boundary and does not widen provider, database, Production, or DNS mutation authority.
The portable Staging manifest is treated as a registered generated artifact and is not manually edited.
